confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live menus or listings. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors are firmer; hostel and hotel rates vary widely in July peak season. Cocktail and wine use a beer-relative basis (about 2.3x and 1.0x the beer anchor) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX rate of 0.6955 comes from a search-result summary that attributes it to the RBA overview page for 4pm on 15 Oct 2026. It was not confirmed against the F11.1 table, and that page's date labels were inconsistent.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated mainly to London and Florence. Beer, coffee, restaurant and hotel anchors sit at or below London, mid-range meals fall between Florence and London, and hostel beds are set above both to reflect July peak demand in Vienna.
